name: Fernanda Vianna

credits.overview: Mesmerized by the image of an active volcano on the other side of the world, a woman sets out to meet her fury. credits.title: O Lodo
credits.overview: Manfredo seeks out a psychiatrist. The doctor insists on knowing his past, but there is something that Manfredo doesn't want to reveal and he abandons treatment. Dr. Pink starts to chase Manfredo and his life turns into hell.

credits.title: Os Dias Que Escondem as Noites
Uma Noite Não é Nada
credits.overview: São Paulo, 1984. Agostinho, an old and tired Physics professor, is married to Januária, a retired school principal. In his classes, he begins to feel attracted to one of his students, Márcia, an HIV positive teenager. Quickly, the attraction of the two turns into an impossible love.

credits.title: O Natal de Rita
credits.overview: Rita was fired from work and has no courage to tell her family. Your chance to have a nice Christmas dinner for the family is to win the prize for a music cover contest. For that, she needs to remember her youth, when she imitated Rita Lee, and revive her band with her husband, Roberto and her friend Marguê.

credits.title: GRUPO GALPÂO: Romeu & Julieta na Praça do Papa
credits.overview: William Shakespeare's classic tale of impossible love between two young people from rival families, adapted to the context of Brazilian popular culture by director Gabriel Villela. Considered a milestone in the history of Grupo Galpão and one of the most significant plays in Brazilian theater in the 1990s.

credits.title: Tio Vânia (aos que vierem depois de nós)
Mão na Luva
credits.overview: Sylvia and Lúcio have decided to separate after twelve years of living together. The last night under the same roof is marked by memories, accusations and revelations that will change their lives.

credits.title: GRUPO GALPÂO: Os Gigantes da Montanha na Praça do Papa
The Moving Creatures
credits.overview: Three families, in three different situations, have to deal with a sudden change in their lives, caused by a loss or a re encounter. Three mothers sing their love for their children while facing difficult times. A film about affection on the borders of painful happenings.

credits.title: País do Desejo
credits.overview: Roberta is a renowned classical pianist battling a chronic kidney disease. However, an unexpected encounter with Father José will forever change her life.
